text:
release-manager: FYI — I'm trying to promote release v2026.03.21 into prod during the 02:00 UTC change window. Deploybot preflight ran but the prompt/eval gate flagged a regression for the autocomplete-summarizer prompt set. Need recommendation: rollback, pin, or rollforward with a hotfix.

dev-deploybot: Deploybot preflight summary:
- test_suite: prompt-suite/v2.1
- failure_rate_delta: +4.8% (regression threshold 3%)
- affected_route: /api/summarize/autocomplete
- failing_example_count: 12/240
> full report: https://ci.internal/reports/4956789123

aj: quick look at diffs: quality drop seen mainly on short-context prompts (<= 32 tokens). Longer prompts look fine. Seems like a quantization tweak from last model build.

maria: If it's isolated to short contexts we could do a region-scoped routing change (route EU->stable-variant) and let US continue if SLA allows. But that adds complexity for telemetry.

qa-lead: Our user-impact scoring puts this as medium; regression affects clarity for autocomplete suggestions. Product asked for conservative stance.

samir: Two paths: 1) Rollback to v2026.03.18 (known-good), 2) Pin the older model for the route until we ship a patch, 3) Patch and run a fast re-eval and promote in same window.

product-lead: Product prefers no visible regressions in prod. If rollback is quick and safe, lean rollback. If rollback risks data-migration or side effects, prefer pin or hold until next window.

aj: Rollback time estimate ~7–12 minutes if we trigger the platform rollback; low risk. Pinning estimate ~15–25 minutes (route config+smoke). Hotfix build and re-eval ~40–90m depending on CI queue.

maria: Also consider partial rollforward: create a quick quant-tweak build using previous kernel selection (fast path), run the prompt-suite smoke (sample 50), and if green, promote. We can automate the smoke via `tools/eval/run_smoke --suite prompt-short --sample 50`.

qa-lead: I can run the smoke manually if someone kicks off the build. But that blocks the change window timeline.

release-manager: Decision needed for this window. Options summarized:
- rollback (fastest)
- pin older model for route (safer but longer config work)
- attempt hotfix + smoke (risky for window time)

product-lead: No showstopper business features depend on new behaviors. I'd approve rollback for this window.

samir: OK. I'll start the rollback. @dev-deploybot please schedule rollback to v2026.03.18 for /api/summarize/autocomplete and run post-rollback smoke.

dev-deploybot: @samir acknowledged. Rolling back route /api/summarize/autocomplete to model v2026.03.18 now. ETA 9 minutes. Post-rollback smoke will run (sample 200).

aj: I'll open the follow-up ticket for the quantization investigation and add the preflight artifacts. Ticket: https://rwd/issue/AI-3412 (assigning to aj + eng-ml).

maria: Also updating the changelog and release notes: removing the prod promotion line and adding rollback note. I'll push a short note to release-notes/drafts.

release-manager: Thanks team. After smoke is green we'll mark the release as rolled back and schedule a hotfix in the next change window. Logging decision in the incident channel once confirmed. :white_check_mark:
